7-Zip source, vendored as the pinned release tarball (not a submodule:
ip7z/7zip on GitHub mirrors releases, it is not the development repository).

    version:  26.04  (2026-10-05)
    file:     7z2604-src.tar.xz
    origin:   https://7-zip.org/a/7z2604-src.tar.xz
    sha256:   9691944c0fe0d01bb49373a704fb983fd33bc98b1738695179dfbf99ac1734f6

The hash is re-verified on every build by Scripts/build-7zip-engine.sh against
the pin in Scripts/upstream-pin.sh. Bumping the upstream must be an explicit,
reviewed change to those two files -- never a silent one.

LICENSE
    7-Zip is licensed under the GNU LGPL, with the unRAR code carrying an
    additional restriction. Everything compiled from this tarball lands in
    SevenZipKit.framework, which is therefore LGPL in its entirety and is
    linked dynamically so it stays replaceable. See ../../SevenZipKit/README.md.
